F2-L09.intro: Report what you heard in an introduction — name, age, country, city, languages, hobby — say if a statement is صَحِيحٌ or خَطَأٌ, notice the detail after وَلٰكِنَّ, and ask for the recording مَرَّةً أُخْرَى.

roleplays.setting: A voice message from a new pen-pal
roleplays.title: Sami’s message

tasks.task: Notes: a boy called Sami. Say who spoke.
tasks.en: A boy spoke; his name is Sami.

tasks.task: Notes: Tunisia. Give his country and nationality.
tasks.en: He is from Tunisia; he is Tunisian.

tasks.task: ASK if you can listen again (your classmate then answers).
tasks.model: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ نَسْتَمِعَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى؟

tasks.examiner: صَحِيحٌ أَمْ خَطَأٌ: سَامِي يَتَكَلَّمُ الفَرَنْسِيَّةَ؟
tasks.task: Notes: speaks Arabic and French. Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.en: True, he speaks Arabic and French.

tasks.task: Notes: Dina · 16 · Jordanian. Report all three facts.
tasks.model: اِسْمُهَا دِينَا، عُمْرُهَا سِتَّ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَهِيَ أُرْدُنِيَّةٌ.
tasks.en: Her name is Dina; she is sixteen, and she is Jordanian.

tasks.task: She said: «وُلِدْتُ فِي عَمَّانَ، وَلٰكِنَّنِي أَسْكُنُ فِي لَنْدَنَ». Answer carefully.
tasks.model: تَسْكُنُ فِي لَنْدَنَ، وَلَيْسَ فِي عَمَّانَ.
tasks.en: She lives in London, not in Amman.

tasks.model: عَرَفْتُ مِنْ كَلِمَةِ «وَلٰكِنَّ»؛ المَعْلُومَةُ الصَّحِيحَةُ بَعْدَهَا.
tasks.en: I knew from the word “but”; the correct information comes after it.

tasks.examiner: … الفِكْرَةُ الرَّئِيسِيَّةُ هِيَ المَوْضُوعُ العَامُّ، وَالتَّفَاصِيلُ هِيَ المَعْلُومَاتُ الصَّغِيرَةُ.
tasks.task: ASK the difference between the main idea and the details (the teacher then answers).
tasks.model: مَا الفَرْقُ بَيْنَ الفِكْرَةِ الرَّئِيسِيَّةِ وَالتَّفَاصِيلِ؟
tasks.en: What is the difference between the main idea and the details?

tasks.task: Notes: cooking. Answer the unexpected question.

roleplays.setting: Summarising a radio phone-in for your class
roleplays.title: Three young callers

tasks.task: Notes: three callers — two boys and a girl.
tasks.en: Three people spoke: two boys and a girl.

tasks.task: Notes: Ahmad · 15 · Sudanese · lives in Cardiff · football.
tasks.help: الأَوَّلُ اسْمُهُ …؛ عُمْرُهُ … ، وَهُوَ … ، وَيَسْكُنُ … ، وَهِوَايَتُهُ …
tasks.model: الأَوَّلُ اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ؛ عُمْرُهُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَهُوَ سُودَانِيٌّ، وَيَسْكُنُ فِي كَارْدِيف، وَهِوَايَتُهُ كُرَةُ القَدَمِ.
tasks.en: The first is called Ahmad; he is fifteen, Sudanese, lives in Cardiff, and his hobby is football.

tasks.task: Notes: Reem · 14 · Iraqi · Arabic, English and Kurdish.
tasks.model: اِسْمُهَا رِيمُ؛ عُمْرُهَا أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَهِيَ عِرَاقِيَّةٌ، وَتَتَكَلَّمُ ثَلَاثَ لُغَاتٍ: العَرَبِيَّةَ وَالإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةَ وَالكُرْدِيَّةَ.
tasks.en: Her name is Reem; she is fourteen, Iraqi, and speaks three languages: Arabic, English and Kurdish.

tasks.examiner: … قَالَ إِنَّهُ مِنَ اليَمَنِ، وَعُمْرُهُ ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
tasks.task: You missed the third caller. ASK what he said (the teacher then answers).
tasks.model: لَمْ أَسْمَعِ المُتَّصِلَ الثَّالِثَ جَيِّدًا؛ مَاذَا قَالَ؟
tasks.en: I didn’t hear the third caller well; what did he say?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question with two reasons.
tasks.model: أَحْمَدُ يُشْبِهُنِي أَكْثَرَ، لِأَنَّ عُمْرَهُ مِثْلُ عُمْرِي، وَلِأَنَّهُ يُحِبُّ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ مِثْلِي.
tasks.en: Ahmad is most like me, because he is my age, and because he loves football like me.

conversation.q: مَاذَا تَقُولُ إِذَا لَمْ تَسْمَعْ جَيِّدًا؟
conversation.qen: What do you say if you didn’t hear well?
True or false: “I am a hundred years old”?
What do you do before you listen?
conversation.model: أَقْرَأُ الأَسْئِلَةَ أَوَّلًا، وَأُفَكِّرُ فِي الكَلِمَاتِ، مِثْلَ الاِسْمِ وَالعُمْرِ.
conversation.en: I read the questions first and think about the words, like name and age.

conversation.qen: What are the key words in an introduction?
conversation.model: الكَلِمَاتُ المُهِمَّةُ: اِسْمِي، عُمْرِي، أَنَا مِنْ، أَسْكُنُ فِي، وَأَتَكَلَّمُ.
conversation.en: The key words are: my name, my age, I am from, I live in, and I speak.

conversation.qen: How do you know the speaker is a girl?
conversation.starter: أَعْرِفُ مِنَ الكَلِمَاتِ، مِثْلَ … ، وَأَيْضًا مِنَ …
conversation.model: أَعْرِفُ مِنَ الكَلِمَاتِ، مِثْلَ «أَنَا بِرِيطَانِيَّةٌ» أَوْ «سَعِيدَةٌ»، وَأَيْضًا مِنَ الاِسْمِ.
conversation.en: I know from the words, like “barīṭāniyya” or “saʿīda”, and also from the name.

conversation.q: مَاذَا سَمِعْتَ فِي آخِرِ تَمْرِينِ اسْتِمَاعٍ؟
conversation.qen: What did you hear in the last listening exercise?
conversation.starter: سَمِعْتُ … تُقَدِّمُ / يُقَدِّمُ نَفْسَهُ؛ اِسْمُهَا / اِسْمُهُ … ، وَ…
conversation.model: سَمِعْتُ بِنْتًا تُقَدِّمُ نَفْسَهَا؛ اِسْمُهَا هِنْدُ، وَهِيَ مِنْ سُورِيَا.
conversation.en: I heard a girl introducing herself; her name is Hind, and she is from Syria.

conversation.starter: نَسْتَمِعُ أَوَّلًا لِـ … ، ثُمَّ … لِـ … ، مِثْلَ …
conversation.model: نَسْتَمِعُ أَوَّلًا لِلْفِكْرَةِ الرَّئِيسِيَّةِ، ثُمَّ نَسْتَمِعُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى لِلتَّفَاصِيلِ، مِثْلَ الأَعْمَارِ وَالمُدُنِ.
conversation.en: We listen first for the main idea, then once more for the details, like ages and cities.

conversation.q: مَا الكَلِمَةُ الَّتِي تُغَيِّرُ المَعْلُومَةَ أَحْيَانًا؟
conversation.qen: Which word sometimes changes the information?
conversation.model: كَلِمَةُ «وَلٰكِنَّ»؛ مَثَلًا: «أَنَا مِنْ مِصْرَ، وَلٰكِنَّنِي أَسْكُنُ فِي لَنْدَنَ»، فَالسَّكَنُ فِي لَنْدَنَ.
conversation.en: The word “but”; for example: “I am from Egypt, but I live in London”, so the home is London.

conversation.q: قَدِّمْ نَفْسَكَ بِبُطْءٍ وَوُضُوحٍ لِطَالِبٍ يَسْتَمِعُ.
conversation.qen: Introduce yourself slowly and clearly for a student who is listening.
conversation.starter: مَرْحَبًا. اِسْمِي … . عُمْرِي … . أَنَا مِنْ … ، وَأَسْكُنُ فِي …
conversation.model: مَرْحَبًا. اِسْمِي آدَمُ. عُمْرِي أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً. أَنَا مِنْ بِرِيطَانِيَا، وَأَسْكُنُ فِي لَنْدَنَ.
conversation.en: Hello. My name is Adam. I am fourteen. I am from Britain, and I live in London.

conversation.qen: How will you improve your listening at home?
conversation.model: سَأَسْتَمِعُ إِلَى قِصَصٍ قَصِيرَةٍ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، وَسَأَكْتُبُ الكَلِمَاتِ الجَدِيدَةَ.
conversation.en: I will listen to short stories in Arabic every day, and I will write down the new words.
